classes.name: Finding
classes.description: A reported security problem, unique per namespace by problem signature. Repeated reports are occurrences, not new findings.

properties.name: source
properties.description: Who reported it: probe, review, scanner, agent, or advisory.

properties.name: problem_signature
properties.description: Stable signature that identifies the problem; findings with the same signature collapse into one.

properties.name: reported_severity
properties.description: Severity as reported by the source.

properties.name: evidence_refs
properties.description: Evidence references retained as a single string value.

classes.name: FindingOccurrence
classes.description: One measured observation of a finding. The occurrence id is unique per namespace, so a replayed observation never counts twice.

properties.name: occurrence_id
properties.description: Source identifier of the observation; unique per namespace.

properties.name: observed_at_ms
properties.description: When the source observed it, in Unix milliseconds.

properties.name: evidence_refs
properties.description: Evidence references retained as a single string value.

classes.name: SecurityHypothesis
classes.description: A proposed explanation, for example from a model. It is not a measured fact and cannot be cited as exposure evidence.

properties.name: finding_id
properties.description: The finding this hypothesis is about.

classes.name: Exposure
classes.description: One finding against one deployed target (release and environment), with a verdict and the measured evidence used.

properties.name: evidence_id
properties.description: Measured occurrence the verdict relies on; required unless the verdict is unknown.

relations.name: hypothesizes
relations.description: A hypothesis is about a finding.

relations.name: exposes
relations.description: An exposure places a finding on a deployed target.

relations.name: evidenced_by
relations.description: An exposure verdict relies on a measured occurrence.
